te01.matches: The TE-01 master specification establishes the baseplate, shaft diameter, bearing and vane counts, and target envelope.
te01.limits: The rotor diameter and final fits remain open in the master specification. TE-01 is a project design with its own dimensions.

re01.matches: The project manual defines the foundation, journals and crank-slider. The Rockwell transcript supplies component terminology.
re01.limits: The Rockwell reference supplies no manufacturing dimensions for the filmed equipment. It has a separate historical archive entry.

me01.matches: The master specification defines the foundation, the two coaxial shafts, the rotor and guard radii, and the coupling length parameter.
me01.limits: ME-01 originates in this repository. Hardware qualification, final tolerances, and installation interfaces remain open.

references.alt: General Electric handbook page 802 with the operation description and dimensional and wiring availability notes

ge-1962.matches: Figure 1 shows the scalloped base, two exterior supports, cylindrical case, exposed fan, crown rail and meters. Page 802 specifies two aligned bearings, six internal vanes, forty-seven brushes with individual feeds, and two meters.
ge-1962.limits: The surviving handbook lists the dimension drawing and external wiring as supplied on delivery. The CAD dimensions, hidden contours, brush spacing and feed routing remain nominal.

chrysler.matches: The film shows the transmission demonstrator and its visible housing. The reconstruction follows the visible bell outline, ribbing and service split.
chrysler.limits: A604 / 41TE is a comparison candidate. The film does not establish the casting number. Internal fluid geometry, flange hardware, dimensions and fits are nominal.

micro-2016.matches: The presentation shows an open hinged enclosure, lid terminals and lid-to-tray cabling.
micro-2016.limits: Enclosure dimensions, hinge pin specification, wiring pinout and internal equipment positions remain estimated.

electro-2021.matches: The instrument images show bench packaging and an unpopulated pad field. The publisher identifies two spurving resonators in the acquisition path.
electro-2021.limits: A dimensioned chassis drawing, PCB layout file, netlist and component values remain unavailable. Geometry and circuit parameters are project estimates.

magneto-2022.matches: The builder shows lobed carriers, satellite magnet disks, end disks and supports.
magneto-2022.limits: The CAD represents the visible carrier arrangement and includes 160 insert solids in its modeled set. Exact total hardware allocation, polarity, grading and spacings require a build drawing.

crypto-2019.matches: Figure 1 supplies the layered signal flow and feedback paths used as the reference for the operating study.
crypto-2019.limits: The document gives no mechanical dimensions or numerical transition matrix. The operating study uses project-defined states and probabilities.

mini-2022.matches: The illustrated schematic defines the ATTiny85 circuit. The course gives a 1.575 × 1.26 in (40.005 × 32.004 mm) mounting pattern with 3.2 mm holes and specifies the debounce network.
mini-2022.limits: The course delegates the board outline and component placement. The published student example has a 0.635 mm gap at one Edge.Cuts corner, so the native file remains the reference for that revision.
